paths.name: @/db
paths.message: Route handlers and app pages must not use the unscoped database client — that is how the last three cross-tenant bugs happened. Use forUser(user.id) from @/lib/tenant-db, or a userId-taking function from @/lib/db-queries / @/lib/db-mutations. If this file genuinely cannot be scoped, add an eslint-disable-next-line with a TODO saying why and who finishes it.
